60061.name: Ballistic Calibration I
60061.SpecificEffects:
When engaging in combat with a target at Ideal Range, gain DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+2%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+6%</color>.

RelatedDescription: This backpack incorporates a special combat-support chip and an all-in-one control unit to enhance the ST's destructive power at Ideal Range.
